chunks: Al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Any food for which you have specified a measure should not be sold by estimation. This is among what is disliked in the sale of food.

key_terms.بَيْعِ الطَّعَامِ: the commercial sale of food items
key_terms.كَيْلًا: a specified measure or volume used in sale
key_terms.مُجَازَفَةً: sale by estimation without precise measuring

ai.seo_question: Can measured food be sold by estimation in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith states that when food is designated as a measured commodity, it should not be sold merely by rough estimation. It addresses proper conduct in sale transactions and indicates that such a practice is disliked in food sales.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3829 - Al-Halabi narrated from Abu Abdullah (as):
"Any food for which a specific measure has been stated cannot be sold by estimation. This is among the practices that are disliked in selling food."
